notes.title: Patch Notes For alpha playtest 0.16.0.11702
notes.notes:
The last playtest build was made using the 'demo' tag instead of 'playtest', which resulted in having the save game in a different file. This build is correcting this issue.

A few people will still be impacted by the fix, if they've been playing over the last few days. Save game files can be retrieved here:

C:\Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\XperimentalZ Games\Escape the Mad Empire

So if the save game seem to have 'reset', you can go there and move files around to retrieve it. All our apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update Notes for alpha playtest 0.16.0.11351
notes.notes:
- Revamped early game progression with a new in-dungeon quests-based tutorial and smoother progression curve.
- Introduced new story special rooms and mini-boss events early-game.
- Introduced a new energy bar system: there's now more skills on cooldown but every action now cost energy.
- Revamped the stats system to make sure that each stat is significant from a gameplay point of view.
- The new update is not compatible with older versions, so the game will start on new save files.
- Bunch of fixes and quality of life tweaks, including key binding.
- Started rolling localization, in an incomplete state.

notes.title: Update Notes for Alpha Playtest 0.1.0.8743 version
notes.notes:
Alpha Playtest 0.1.0.8743 Notes:

We disabled the Curse of the Undead King Prologue and added a new game mode called Escape Runs.

The Escape Runs are short & intense series of 3 dungeons where the player has to survive the last battle in order to win. New difficulty levels are unlocked after each victory. 

Can you win the hellish 5th level? Can you Escape the Mad Empire?
